title: Nourishing Daily Oil Wash

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Body Wash & Shower Gel > Bath & Shower > Bath & Body

descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free

What it is: A gentle body cleanser that provides an intensely nourishing wash, formulated without soap or sulfates.


Formulation: Liquid


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Blend of Natural Oils: A naturally derived oil blend that gently cleanses, smooths, and nourishes skin.

- Glycerin: A trustworthy hydrator that attracts and retains moisture.

- Vitamin E: A natural antioxidant that supports the skin’s moisture barrier and helps defend against free radicals.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of sulfates SLS & SLES. It is also cruelty-free.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-In the shower, massage generously all over wet skin. The oil will emulsify into a soft, frothy lather as it cleanses.
-Don’t forget to take a moment for yourself and breathe the blend of the scent in.
-Rinse thoroughly.
Ingredients+

-Blend of Natural Oils: A naturally derived oil blend that gently cleanses, smooths, and nourishes skin.

-Glycerin: A trustworthy hydrator that attracts and retains moisture.

-Vitamin E: A natural antioxidant that supports the skin’s moisture barrier and helps defend against free radicals.


Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Isopropylamine Dodecylbenzenesulfonate, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Glyceryl Caprylate/Caprate, Fragrance/Parfum, Dimethyl Lauramide/Myristamide, Linalool, Glycine Soja (Soybean) Oil, Glycerin, Phytosterols, Tocopherol, Water/Aqua/Eau, Hexyl Cinnamal, Geraniol, Limonene, Citronellol.
